Child body shapes for the Heartverse child heart lab.

Source: MakeHuman base mesh and macro (age) targets, generated with the MPFB add-on 2.0.18 in Blender 5.3.0
by tools/generate_body.py on 2026-11-17. Three shapes on one mesh: baby (1 year), child (10 years), 14 years.
Includes MakeHuman's eye and eyelash helpers and its tights helper cut to shorts; lips and nails weights from
MPFB's skin masks; scalp from MPFB's scalp face list. One level of subdivision.
Settings: neutral gender, average muscle, weight, proportions and height, equal ethnicity mix.

Licence: MakeHuman core assets are shared under CC0.
https://static.makehumancommunity.org/about/license.html

The page interpolates between the shapes by age and scales the body to a rounded typical height.
It is an illustration of body shape, not a measurement of any child.
